clarification_needed.topic: weather forecast feed at serving time
clarification_needed.question: is_hot_day and is_heavy_rain are included for h=1 and h=7 models, evaluated at the TARGET date. This assumes a 7-day weather forecast will be available at serving time. If no weather forecast feed is integrated, these columns should be evaluated at ORIGIN instead (or dropped for h>1).
clarification_needed.recommendation: use weather at TARGET date for h<=7 (forecast feed assumed)
clarification_needed.recommendation_reasoning: A 7-day weather forecast is widely available; using origin weather for h=7 gives a 7-day-old observation with no predictive value.
clarification_needed.impact_if_wrong: Model trained on observed weather at target date but served on origin weather; scores optimistic at h=7; mild MAE degradation at serving time.

agent_initiated_findings.title: smedian_w4 Part A winner introduces different NaN pattern than smedian_w52
agent_initiated_findings.findings: smedian_w4 (4-week window) requires only 4 same-DOW observations at origin. This means valid predictions start ~28 days into the series, versus ~364 days for smedian_w52. NaN rows at series start are fewer (4 vs 52 same-DOW obs needed). All NaN rows are ffill/bfill filled with expanding window stats.
agent_initiated_findings.reasoning: smedian_w4 is the new Part A winner post-revised baseline; its NaN pattern differs from prior runs.

agent_initiated_findings.title: h=1 and h=7 share the same lag column (bread_lag_7d) and same naive predictors
agent_initiated_findings.findings: ceil(1/7)=1 and ceil(7/7)=1, so both h=1 and h=7 use bread_lag_7d. Similarly, naive_h1_smedian_w4 and naive_h7_smedian_w4 are computed at different origins (D-1 vs D-7) but both look at the same 4 same-DOW observations (D-7, D-14, D-21, D-28 relative to target D), making them identical. Training should verify this redundancy and may choose to train a single model for both horizons or include only one of the two predictors.
agent_initiated_findings.reasoning: Noted to avoid Training from treating h=1 and h=7 as informationally different when their naive predictors are identical.

handoff.read_this_first: FE output is a wide-format CSV indexed by TARGET date. naive_h{h}_* columns are computed at origin D-h for that h only — do not cross-use. horizon_feature_subsets in parameters gives the exact feature list for each h-model. Weather (is_hot_day, is_heavy_rain) evaluated at TARGET date — available only for h<=7 (7-day forecast horizon). Clarification CQ-FE-001 (non-blocking) on weather feed.

horizon_feature_subsets.why: Training must use the subset for its horizon; using all cols would include invalid lags and cross-horizon naive predictors.

naive_predictor_cols_all_horizons.why: Protected columns — Training must include all of them for their respective horizon model.

protected_features.why: Inherited from baseline; cannot be dropped without user approval.

baseline_floor_per_horizon.why: Every trained model must beat these MAEs per horizon before being accepted.

weather_note.value: is_hot_day and is_heavy_rain are in the CSV evaluated at TARGET date. Use only for h<=7 models. See CQ-FE-001.
weather_note.why: Weather forecast only reliable 7 days ahead; beyond that, use weather_data_available instead.

durable_rules.rule: Use horizon_feature_subsets exactly — do not give h=7 naive predictors to the h=30 model.
durable_rules.why: naive_h7_* is computed at origin D-7; at h=30 it reads 23 days after the h=30 origin = leakage.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Model trains and scores on leakage; deployment produces silent errors.

durable_rules.rule: Target column for h-model is bread_quantity_h{h} (date-based join), not shift(-h).
durable_rules.why: shift(-h) moves rows, not calendar days; on this series (non-trading days removed) it maps to wrong weekday.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: Up to +5 weekday offset pre-regime; model predicts wrong DOW.

durable_rules.rule: Every trained h-model must report MAE vs baseline_floor for its horizon before acceptance.
durable_rules.why: Inherited from baseline. The floor is the best trivial rule's MAE.
durable_rules.cost_if_broken: A model worse than the floor may be accepted without notice.

methodological_cautions.caution: is_official_public_holiday has 99% same-DOW overlap with zero-demand days. Training should not include it alongside DOW dummies without regularisation — they are near-collinear.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Inflated importance estimate for DOW; holiday coefficient absorbed into DOW.

methodological_cautions.caution: naive_h1_smedian_w4 and naive_h7_smedian_w4 are mathematically identical (same 4 same-DOW observations relative to target). Training can verify and treat h=1 and h=7 as sharing the same naive predictor.
methodological_cautions.cost_if_ignored: Spurious distinction; wasted separate model if they perform identically.

do_not_repeat.tried: Using row-shift (df.shift(-h)) for horizon target construction
do_not_repeat.evidence: Prior run_20260904T140437Z used shift(-h); produced wrong weekday targets on 6-day trading week. This run uses date-based lookup.
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: shift(-h) on a non-gapless frame (missing non-trading days) maps to wrong calendar day.

do_not_repeat.tried: Evaluating weather at ORIGIN for all horizons
do_not_repeat.evidence: Prior run included 12 weather columns at all horizons; all scored ~0 MAE contribution. Weather at origin for h=90 is a 3-month-old observation.
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: Origin weather for h>7 carries no signal; use target-date weather forecast for h<=7.
